about.title: Ecology of *Clarity*
about.p1: A complete recalibration of your inner and outer world, by clearing your space, your time and your relationships.
bubble: A gentle yet profound transformation of your life, starting with your home, your time and your relationships.
Together, we clear away what no longer serves you, simplify what feels overwhelming and make room for what brings you peace, meaning and joy.
Because when your outer world becomes clearer, your inner world can breathe, too.

way.title: Clear your space. Reclaim your time. Live *authentically*.
way.intro: Imagine a home that supports you instead of overwhelming you, routines that give you structure without taking your freedom, and relationships that nourish rather than drain you. The result is more than a tidy home. It is a life that feels like your own again. Less overwhelm, more clarity, more life.

meta.title: My journey · Aurea
meta.description: Philosophy, heritage, gender studies, Indian classical dance, Vedānta, contemplative prayer, pilgrimage and motherhood: the journey of Elena Repka.

journeyPage.title: A life of crossing *boundaries*
journeyPage.intro: Fashion, women's networks, cultural work, dance and retreats: my path has been a wide one. These are the places that shaped it.
journeyPage.closing: Not a collection of places, but one question: how to live a *whole* life.

places.line: Where it began: philosophy, art and European aesthetics.
Among the Minangkabau, where house, land and lineage pass through women.
Classical dance, Vedānta and the sacred sites of the South.
The Char Dham Yatra, high in the mountains.
With my daughters, on the way of Mary Magdalene.
In the footsteps of St Francis and St Clare.
Weeks of silence and prayer with Benedictine monks.
Today: research, coaching, and three grown children.

approach.title: My *Approach*
paragraphs: My work brings together solution-focused coaching, psychology, yoga, movement, creative exploration, and contemplative practices. Drawing on my interdisciplinary background, I offer individual sessions, group experiences, workshops, and retreats designed to support self-awareness, personal development, and meaningful change.

I believe that each person carries resources, strengths, and possibilities that can be discovered and developed. My approach combines attentive listening, curiosity, and practical exploration with an appreciation for the relationship between mind, body, creativity, and our wider cultural experience.

items.name: Solution-Focused Life Coaching
items.text: I offer individual coaching sessions informed by Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT). This approach focuses on your desired future, existing strengths, and the small, meaningful steps that can help you move forward. Together, we explore possibilities and develop practical ways to create change in your life.

items.name: Yoga & Embodied Practice
items.text: My yoga sessions draw on my training as a certified Hatha Yoga teacher and my experience as a Bikram Hot Yoga practitioner. The practice can support body awareness, movement, concentration, and a more attentive relationship with yourself.

items.name: Therapeutic & Creative Exploration
items.text: Drawing on my background in art therapy, art education, and movement, I offer space for reflection and creative exploration. The precise format and focus of these sessions can be tailored to your practice and professional scope.

groups.name: Four Clearings Masterclass
groups.text: Four Clearings is a 4-week guided masterclass for women at midlife who are ready to make room for the life that is truly theirs now: in their space, time, relationships and inner life.

groups.name: Workshops & Group Sessions
groups.text: Workshops and group sessions bring women together around a shared theme. Depending on the format, they combine solution-focused approaches, movement, yoga, reflection, creative practice and conversation.

groups.name: Retreats & Walks
groups.text: Retreats and guided walks offer time away from everyday routines, in Umbria, Lazio and Provence. Walking slowly through these landscapes leaves room to rest, reflect and listen more deeply.

background.title: Professional *Background*
paragraphs: My professional experience spans art curation and education, art therapy, tourism and high-end fashion. I curated Slovak fashion, worked in women's business networks and cultural associations, founded and led a folk dance ensemble in Vienna, and organised retreats and workshops across Slovakia and Italy.

All of this taught me how to create spaces of beauty, trust, movement and reflection. Today I bring it into my work with women who are ready to step into the next chapter of their lives with more clarity, vitality and presence.

pilgrimagePage.title:
A pilgrimage to *clarity*.
Coming home to yourself in the heart of Umbria.
pilgrimagePage.intro: Sometimes you don't need another plan. You need time and space to find out what you really want.

retreat.title: Time that is *yours*
paragraphs: I invite you to spend 3 to 5 days in Umbria, Italy. Stop, slow down and step out of the everyday rush for a while.
In the quiet town of Spoleto I make room for women who need to recharge, sort out their thoughts and rediscover what truly matters to them.
retreat.listTitle: During your stay I accompany you with
items: Yoga and movement, to release your body and feel good in it again
Breathwork and meditation, to calm your mind and hear yourself
Gentle Ayurvedic guidance, to support your body's natural balance
Personal conversations, to look at where you are, name what you want to change and find concrete next steps
retreat.closing: So that you go home rested, clearer and with a better sense of where you want your life to go.

pilgrimagePage.routeTitle: Walking the land, and back to *yourself*
pilgrimagePage.routeIntro: Part of the stay is a walk through the Umbrian countryside to Assisi, home of St Francis and St Clare. Choose the shorter walk from Spello to Assisi (about 11 km), or the whole way from Spoleto to Assisi (about 65 km) over five days.

Yoga, movement, breathwork, meditation and spiritual practice
Personal conversations to find your own direction
Travel can be arranged on request
take: A clearer idea of what you want, and what you no longer need
Perhaps the courage to take a first step in a new direction
pilgrimagePage.takeLine: It doesn't matter how fast you walk. What matters is where the path *leads you*.

meta.title: Research · Aurea
meta.description: Women on the threshold: embodied pilgrimage, Marian devotion and the reorganisation of women's lives. Research by Elena Repka.

researchPage.title: Women on the *threshold*
researchPage.subtitle: Embodied pilgrimage, Marian devotion and the reorganisation of women's lives
researchPage.intro: My research grows out of my own life: years of walking, praying and studying sacred traditions across Europe and India. It asks what pilgrimage does to women, and what women do with pilgrimage when they return home.
questions: How do women negotiate the boundary between traditional Catholic devotion and contemporary forms of spirituality?
What happens to the meaning of pilgrimage after returning home?
What does a woman carry home, and what does she leave behind?
researchPage.field: Ethnographic research among women pilgrims to Mariazell, Austria's most important Marian shrine, and among the ageing communities along its pilgrim paths.
researchPage.comparative: A dialogue between two traditions of embodied transformation: European Christian pilgrimage, with its walking, sacred landscapes and return, and Indian embodied traditions, with their attention to body, consciousness, ritual and Śakti.
researchPage.positionality: As both researcher and pilgrim, I make my own position transparent: this is reflexive ethnography, written from inside the experience it studies.
researchPage.contactText: For conferences, academic exchange and research collaboration, I'd be glad to hear from you.

masterclassPage.title: Four Clearings to make *room* for your life
masterclassPage.intro: A guided masterclass for women at midlife who have carried many roles and cared for many people, and now feel ready for more space, clarity and vitality in their own lives.

why.title: Why *now*
paragraphs: Around fifty, you know that a life is more than a job title, a relationship status or a list of achievements. You may have been the woman who wanted to belong, who tried to get everything right, who cared for others, who chased success.

Now quieter questions arrive. What is truly mine? What wants to come alive through me now? This masterclass is not about becoming a different woman, or a minimalist. It is about returning to a life that supports who you are today.

how.title: How it *works*
paragraphs: Each week we look, with kindness and precision, at one area of your life. Nothing is rushed, and nothing from your past has to be thrown away. You notice what supports your next chapter, what drains you, and what no longer belongs.
The work is practical and personal, and follows an Ayurvedic protocol to support your energy and vitality. You clear not only what is visible, but also what quietly takes up your attention.

clearings.title: The four *clearings*
prompts: What in my space supports the woman I am becoming?
What am I keeping out of habit, guilt or an old identity?
What takes my time without nourishing my life?
Which commitments belong to an older version of me?
Which relationships feel mutual and alive?
Who am I when I no longer need to be everything for everyone?
What have I postponed for too long?

receive.title: What you *receive*
items: Four weeks of guidance through the four clearings
An Ayurvedic protocol to support the process
Reflection prompts and practical exercises for each week
Space to work at your own pace

cta.title: One drawer. One hour. One boundary. One *truth*.
cta.note: A life can begin to change from there.
